relationships.subject: Pellino-1
relationships.evidence_quote: The overexpression of Pellino-1 increased the visceral sensitivity of CRD rats, and the expression of TLR4 and NF-κB increased further.

relationships.subject: TAK-242
relationships.evidence_quote: After administration of TAK-242 (a specific TLR4 inhibitor), the visceral response to overexpression of Pellino-1 was reversed.

key_findings: Pellino-1 is downregulated in the fastigial nucleus of CRD rats while TLR4 and NF-κB are upregulated.
Pellino-1 overexpression raised visceral sensitivity via TLR4/NF-κB, reversed by TAK-242.
